DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お口座のご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to discuss an account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。家族から残高を聞いてきてと頼まれましたが、その人の資料や委任の準備はまだありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族残高照会依頼と委任資料なしを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. A family member asked me to find out their balance, but I have not prepared their documents or authorization yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that a family member asked you to check their balance and that you have no authorization documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人も来られていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the account holder here with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日は来ていません。私の口座の残高なら聞けても、家族分まで同じではないと思い相談しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人不在と自分の口座権限の違いを述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, not today. I came to ask because I think being able to check my own account balance does not give me the same access to my family's accounts.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State that the account holder is absent and distinguish this from your authority over your own account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認できる範囲と必要資料を担当へ聞きましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's ask the staff member what can be checked and what documents are needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。家族の暗証番号を教えてもらって、自分で操作するつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 準備範囲確認を頼み他人番号で操作しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I do not intend to get my family member's PIN and operate the account myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask what preparations are needed and say you will not operate the account using someone else's PIN. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご家族へ連絡できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you contact your family member?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。必要な本人確認があれば、本人から案内を確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族へ連絡し本人確認を本人から進める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. If identity verification is required, I will ask them to check the instructions themselves.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Contact your family member and have the account holder proceed with identity verification. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日はご自身の手続きもありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you also have any transactions of your own today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分の記帳があります。それは別に進め、家族の残高を確認済みとは伝えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自身記帳と家族未確認相談を別に扱う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I need to update my passbook. I will do that separately and will not tell my family member that their balance has been confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Treat your own passbook update separately from the inquiry about your family's unconfirmed balance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご自身の記帳と、家族の相談に必要な準備を分けてご案内します。本人の情報を混ぜずにお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will guide you separately through updating your passbook and preparing for your family's inquiry. Please keep each person's information separate when explaining.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about the label?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この数値は一袋全部の分ですか。私は二回に分けて食べるつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 栄養数値が一袋かを尋ね二回喫食予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Are these figures for the entire bag? I plan to eat it in two sittings.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the nutrition figures are for one bag and explain that you plan to eat it in two sittings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示の単位はこちらにあります。一袋当たりですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The unit is shown here. It says per bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。ひと口分の数値だと思っていましたが、袋全体です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一口分と誤解した表示単位を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see. I thought the figures were for one bite, but they are for the whole bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct your misunderstanding that the label's unit was one bite. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 使う量も確認して選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also check how much you will use when choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。二回に分けるなら、それぞれどのくらい食べるかも考えます。必ず半分になるとは、量を決めずに言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 各回の量なしに数値半分としないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. If I split it into two sittings, I will consider how much to eat each time. I cannot say the figures will definitely be half without deciding the amounts.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you cannot halve the figures without knowing the amount for each sitting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかの商品も比較しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Would you like to compare other products too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 比べたいです。片方が百グラム当たりなら、同じ単位にして見ないと分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 百グラム表示と一袋表示を同単位で比較する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. If one is labeled per hundred grams, I cannot compare them properly unless I use the same unit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Compare the per-hundred-gram and per-bag labels using the same unit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 単位の欄を並べて確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can check the unit sections side by side.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。単位と内容量を見て、予定の量に合う商品を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 単位内容量と予定量を合わせて商品を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will look at the units and net contents and choose a product that suits the amount I plan to eat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose a product by considering the units, net contents, and planned serving amount together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの二品の表示をご覧ください。数値の単位を確認してからお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please look at the labels on these two products. Check the units for the figures before choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 催しについてのお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the event?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。自由に見られると書いてありますが、工作の体験も予約なしでできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自由見学表示が体験予約不要も意味するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It says visitors can look around freely, but can we also do the craft activity without a reservation?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether free viewing also means no reservation is needed for the activity. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 展示の見学と体験は、案内の欄が別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The exhibition visit and the activity have separate sections in the information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうですね。自由見学の表示を、体験の条件として読んでいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 見学条件と体験条件を読み分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: You're right. I was reading the free-viewing notice as a condition for the activity.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the conditions for viewing from those for the activity. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 体験の受付状況を担当へ確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can ask the person in charge about activity availability.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。空きがなければ、今日は展示だけを見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 体験不可なら展示のみを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. If there are no places available, we will just visit the exhibition today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose only the exhibition if the activity is unavailable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 参加したいのは何名ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: How many people want to take part?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 大人一人と子ども一人です。見学の人数と、工作をする人数も分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 大人子どもの参加人数と見学人数を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: One adult and one child. I will also state separately how many will visit and how many will do the craft activity.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the adult and child participant numbers from the visitor numbers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付で条件を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the conditions at reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。体験できると確認する前に、机の材料を取って作り始めたりはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 体験確認前に材料を取って始めないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will not take materials from the table and start making anything before confirming that we can participate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not take materials and start before activity participation is confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 展示は案内に沿ってご覧いただけます。体験の希望は二名分として担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15227-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: You may view the exhibition following the guidance. Please tell the person in charge that two people wish to do the activity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お帰りの経路でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about your return route?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。行きのメモを逆に読めば、帰りも乗り換えられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 往路メモの逆読み利用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Can I make the transfers on the way back by reading my outward-journey notes in reverse?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about using outward-journey notes in reverse. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 方向によって乗り場や接続が変わります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Platforms and connections vary depending on the direction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、行きのホーム番号を帰りにも使わない方がよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 帰路のホームを往路から推測しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I should not use the outward platform numbers for the return trip too, should I?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Do not infer return platforms from the outward journey. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 帰りの目的地と時刻を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me your destination and time for the return trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この駅まで夕方に戻ります。行きと同じ列車でなくても構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 帰着目的地と時間帯を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will return to this station in the evening. It does not have to be the same train as on the outward journey.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify your return destination and time of day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 帰り用の候補を別にお調べします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will look up return options separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。メモの裏へ帰り専用として書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰路専用の案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I would like to write them on the back of my notes specifically for the return trip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for guidance specifically for the return journey. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 行きの案内と混ぜないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please keep them separate from the outward directions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。表は行き、裏は帰りと大きく書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 往復情報を表裏で分けて記す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will write “outward” clearly on the front and “return” on the back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Record outward and return information separately on the front and back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 帰りの候補はこちらです。方向と時刻を確かめてから乗り場へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here are the return options. Check the direction and time before heading to the platform.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書のお受け取りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to collect a certificate?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: もう受け取りました。提出先から不要と言われたので、返して料金も戻りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不要になった発行済証明の返金を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have already collected it. The place I was submitting it to said it was unnecessary. Can I return it and get the fee back?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a refund for an already issued certificate that is no longer needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 発行済みのため、申請前の取消しとは分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: As it has already been issued, we will check this separately from cancellation before an application.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 使っていなくても、まだ申請していないのと同じではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未使用と申請前を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: So even if I have not used it, that is not the same as not having applied yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish an unused certificate from the stage before applying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。発行状況と取扱いを担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. The staff member will check its issuance status and how it should be handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。余った分を別の人に渡して使ってもらうつもりもありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人証明を他人に転用しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I do not intend to give any spare copies to someone else to use either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not let someone else reuse your personal certificate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 何通お受け取りになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: How many copies did you collect?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二通です。両方とも私の情報が載っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人情報入り二通の受取を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report receiving two copies containing your personal information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 領収書もお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you have the receipt too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。証明二通と領収書を見せて、返金が可能か相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 領収書と証明を示し取扱い照会を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I would like to show you the two certificates and the receipt and ask whether a refund is possible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the receipt and certificates and ask staff to check how they should be handled. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へご案内します。返金できると決めず、発行済み二通の取扱いをご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take you to the staff member. Please ask how the two issued copies should be handled without assuming a refund is possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 「よく痛む」とありますが、どのくらいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You wrote “it often hurts.” How often is that?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一日に何度もという意味ではありません。今週三回ありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 頻度表現を週内回数に修正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I do not mean many times a day. It happened three times this week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Replace the vague frequency expression with the number of occurrences this week. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一回はどれくらい続きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: How long did each episode last?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 短い時は数分です。一番長い時は、時計を見ていないのでわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持続時間の既知不明を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The short ones lasted a few minutes. I do not know how long the longest one lasted because I was not watching the clock.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the duration you know from what you do not know. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: わかる範囲で結構です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Just tell us what you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では「いつも」ではなく、「今週三回、長さは一部不明」と伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 曖昧な常時表現を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will say “three times this week, with some durations unknown,” instead of “all the time.”
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Correct the vague expression suggesting constant symptoms. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 症状がない時間もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are there also times when you have no symptoms?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。今はありません。今ないから今週もなかった、とは言いたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現在無症状と過去経過を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I have none right now. I do not want to imply that because I have none now, I had none this week either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish having no symptoms now from the past course of symptoms. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 医師にもその経過をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also tell the doctor about that course of symptoms.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。回数と今の状態を分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 回数と現在状態の別説明を約束する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will explain the number of episodes separately from my current condition.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Promise to explain the frequency and present condition separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 問診に補足しておきます。診察時に、今お話しされた経過を医師へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will add this to your medical questionnaire. During the consultation, please tell the doctor the course of symptoms you just described.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どなたに届いた連絡ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族の電話です。私には届いていませんが、相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族宛連絡の代理相談を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: It came to a family member's phone. I did not receive it myself, but can I ask for advice?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about consulting on behalf of a family member who received a message. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 内容と、ご本人がした対応を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check the content and what the recipient did in response.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 画面の写真はあります。ただ、家族が返信したかはまだ聞けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 写真所持と返信状況不明を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a photo of the screen. However, I have not yet been able to ask whether my family member replied.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have a photo but do not know whether they replied. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認できていることと不明なことを分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please distinguish confirmed facts from things you do not know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。「返信していない」と私が代わりに断定しないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族対応を断定しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will avoid stating on their behalf that they have not replied.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not make definite claims about your family member's response. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お金を送ったかも確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We also need to check whether they sent any money.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族へ聞きます。メッセージの相手には、確認のためでも連絡しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人へ確認し不審相手へ連絡しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will ask my family member. I will not contact the sender of the message, even to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check with the recipient and do not contact the suspicious sender. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご本人と連絡が取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Can you get in touch with the recipient?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今は取れません。写真だけで相談を始め、返事が来たら補足します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現情報で相談し後から補足する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Not right now. I will start the consultation with just the photo and add information when they respond.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Start the consultation using current information and supplement it later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認できた内容からお伺いします。ご本人の対応については、わかった時点でお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will start with what you have confirmed. Please let us know what the recipient did as soon as you find out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 送り方についてのお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking how to send something?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 局留めにしたいです。受取先を郵便局にすれば、差出人の住所も不要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 局留めでの差出人住所の必要を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want it held for collection at a post office. If the delivery address is the post office, does that mean the sender's address is unnecessary too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the sender's address is needed for mail held at a post office. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受取先と差出人の記入は別に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the delivery address and sender details separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分の住所を郵便局の住所にするのではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分住所を受取局住所にしないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I should not put the post office's address as my own address, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that you should not replace your own address with the collection post office's address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。差出人は送る方の情報です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. The sender section is for the information of the person sending it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: わかりました。受取人の名前と、希望する郵便局の名前を持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受取人名と希望局情報を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I brought the recipient's name and the name of their preferred post office.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Provide the recipient's name and preferred post office details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受取人ご本人は、その方法で受け取る予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Does the recipient plan to collect it personally that way?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。ただ、必要な確認書類はまだ聞いていません。案内を相手にも送りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人受取予定と確認書類未把握を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. But I have not yet asked which verification documents are required. I would like to send them the instructions too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that personal collection is planned but you do not yet know the required verification documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 対象の郵便局とお荷物に合わせてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will guide you according to the post office and parcel concerned.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。私の差出人欄を記入してから、受取先の書き方を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 差出人記入と受取先記入を分けて相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. After filling in my sender section, I will check how to write the delivery address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask about filling in the sender and delivery sections separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それぞれの欄を分けて確認しましょう。受取方法の案内も、相手の方へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's check each section separately. Please also pass the collection instructions on to the recipient.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込内容はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you decided on the transfer details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 金額のメモはありますが、通貨が書いていません。日本円だと思ってよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 金額メモの通貨不明を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a note of the amount, but it does not specify a currency. Can I assume it is Japanese yen?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the unspecified currency on your note of the amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 相手に確認してからお手続きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check with the other party before proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。数字だけ見て入力しないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 数字だけで入力しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I will make sure not to enter it based only on the numbers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will not enter the amount based only on the numbers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 国内振込かどうかも確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you also confirmed whether this is a domestic transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。相手の口座情報も途中までしか送られていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 取引区分と口座情報も未確定と申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. They have also sent only part of the recipient account information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State that the transaction type and account details are also unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な情報がそろうまで実行はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The transfer cannot be executed until all necessary information is available.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。確認用の項目だけ教えてください。相手にまとめて聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相手への一括確認項目を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. Please just tell me which items I need to check. I will ask the other party about them all together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for a list of items to check with the other party all at once. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 金額、通貨、振込先などを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the amount, currency, recipient account, and so on.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。返事が来るまでは、申込書の金額欄を空けておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 回答まで金額記入を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will leave the amount field on the application blank until I get a reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hold off on entering the amount until you receive an answer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認項目をご案内します。情報がそろってから、改めてご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will explain the items to check. Please come back to discuss it once you have all the information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちら二点でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will these two items be all?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。同じ商品ですが、一つだけ割引シールがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同品二個の割引差を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. They are the same product, but only one has a discount sticker.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the difference in discounts between two identical products. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それぞれの表示を確認します。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。二個とも割引だと思っていたわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 全品割引を期待していないと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. I was not assuming both were discounted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Make clear that you are not expecting every item to be discounted. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちら一つは通常価格です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: This one is at the regular price.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: わかりました。シールのある方から使いたいので、袋の中でも見分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 使用順のため識別を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I want to use the one with the sticker first, so I would like to be able to tell them apart inside the bag too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to distinguish the items so you can use them in the desired order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いえ、一つの袋で構いません。シールが見える向きに入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一袋でシールを見せる包装を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: No, one bag is fine. Please put them in with the sticker facing where I can see it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for a single bag with the sticker visible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: つぶれない向きでお入れします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will put them in a position that will not crush them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。レシートでは二つの価格が分かれているか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: レシート上の別価格を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will check that the two prices are listed separately on the receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the separate prices on the receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 価格はそれぞれ記載されます。お受け取り後にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Each price will be listed separately. Please check after receiving it.
